hot_topics.synthesis: X is revamping its content creator compensation strategy by ending its previous revenue-sharing program and launching a new 'Original Content Rewards' initiative. This new program, set to begin on September 8th, will require creators to meet specific criteria, including follower counts and impression thresholds, and will base earnings on 'qualified impressions' from Premium subscribers.

Diplomatic efforts regarding the Strait of Hormuz show some positive signs, according to Oman, yet a clear breakthrough remains elusive as Iran has presented new demands and warned a deal might not guarantee the strait's full opening. Meanwhile, tanker sailors continue to face significant dangers, with many vessels in limbo and transit through the crucial waterway still considered perilous.

Enthusiasts are preparing for an upcoming solar eclipse, expected next Wednesday, which will be visible in parts of the U.S. An open-source interactive map has been released to help people track and understand the August 12 total solar eclipse.

items.title: An Amazon data center could have the worst polluting power plant in the country

This 35-turbine plant is initially planned to primarily supply electricity directly to the data center, not the state's main power grid.

Oliver had provoked the company by selling merchandise featuring a squirrel mascot with "Buc-Off" branding.

items.title: Musician and entrepreneur Tom Vek is building a digital music player, but don’t call it retro

items.title: X replaces its revenue-sharing program with ‘Original Content Rewards’
items.summary: X is discontinuing its previous revenue-sharing program and introducing 'Original Content Rewards' on September 8th, requiring creators to meet new eligibility criteria such as 500 verified followers and 500,000 Home Timeline impressions. This new program will base creator earnings on "qualified impressions" from Premium subscribers on original content.
